Prettier Config Generator

Build a .prettierrc config — print width, quotes, semicolons, trailing commas and more.

📖 How to use

  1. Tune the formatting options to your style.
  2. The JSON config updates live.
  3. Copy it or download .prettierrc.
  4. Place the file in your project root — Prettier picks it up automatically.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What format is generated?

Plain JSON — valid as .prettierrc. Prettier also reads it from package.json under "prettier".

What does trailingComma "all" do?

Adds trailing commas wherever valid (arrays, objects, function args) — the modern recommended style.

useTabs vs tabWidth?

useTabs switches indentation to tabs; tabWidth sets the visual width either way.

Where does the file go?

Save as .prettierrc in your project root.
